skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key concepts and theoretical foundations of cost-benefit analysis.
Understand steps and techniques used in cost-benefit analysis.
Apply quantitative and qualitative analysis skills to economic and social data in cost-benefit analysis.
Interpret data related to cost-benefit analysis.
Perform risk analysis in cost-benefit analysis.
Develop communication skills for discussing, reporting, and presenting cost-benefit analysis results.
Develop independent study skills to learn from practical experience.
Work effectively in teams and take responsibility for group tasks.
Develop self-learning abilities to accumulate experience in cost-benefit analysis.
